1758 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
From 05-22, remaining days in 1758:  
May: 9 days (22 to 31 inclusive)  
June: 30, July: 31, Aug: 31, Sep: 30, Oct: 31, Nov: 30, Dec: 31 → total = 9+30+31+31+30+31+30+31 = 223 days.  
325 - 223 = 102 days into 1759.  
1759 is common year. Jan: 31, Feb: 28, Mar: 31 → 31+28=59, 31 more = 90 total by end of March.  
102 - 90 = 12 days into April → April 12, 1759.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1759-04-12
